|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Plays on table. While Inner Strength not on table, opponent may only use 1 combat card per turn. While opponent has 2 Dark Jedi on Naboo, you lose no more than 2 Force to Force drains at opponent's Naboo sites. Let Them Make The First Move may only target droids and spies.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Plays on table. Unless Inner Strength on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. While opponent has 2 Dark Jedi on Naboo, you lose no more than 2 Force to Force drains at opponent’s Naboo sites. Let Them Make The First Move may target only droids and spies.” '''What changed:''' “While” → “Unless”; removed “not”; added “use”; “use 1” → “one”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; moved “target” to a different place in the text.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 1, slip 1. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Affect Mind]].
* Later text: [[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Affect Mind (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Affect Mind]].
